Aleppo | Six civilians injured in shelling on Mare’ city

Aleppo province: SOHR activists have documented the injury of six civilians, where missiles hit a pool in Mare’ city northern of Aleppo.

According to reliable SOHR sources, the missiles were fired from areas holding Kurdish and regime forces in Aleppo countryside.

On April 24, SOHR activists reported that exchanged artillery shelling had renewed between Turkish forces and their proxies on one hand and Kurdish forces on the other hand, on the frontlines of Aleppo countryside that evening.
The Turkish shelling hit Mar’anaz, Ain Dakna, Al-Smoka and Al-Shaikh Eissa villages and the outskirts of Tel Refaat city controlled by Kurdish forces, meanwhile the Kurdish shelling hit the vicinity of Yazbagh village in A’zaz city and Al-Tawes village on the outskirts of Marae’ city northern of Aleppo. However, no information was reported about the damages and casualties.
